input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date").
input.rationale: Section 4.1 gives each Party an unconditional right to terminate on 90 days' notice, with the terminating Party's notice fixing the Termination Date. That satisfies the fallback on the Company side (convenience termination on 90 days' notice) and on HDI's notice period, but it fails the fallback in two material respects: (i) HDI's right is not tied to the end of the then-current term, so HDI can walk away mid-term on 90 days' notice; and (ii) the Termination Payment payable when the Company terminates is a formula (aggregate Net Sales for the preceding twelve months less $800,000, divided by two, payable in eight quarterly instalments) that is uncapped and can far exceed three months of fees. We therefore target the fallback with two short inserts: HDI's termination is effective only at the end of the then-current term, and the Termination Payment is capped at three months of Section 3 fees. The Company's 90-day notice right (short of the preferred 30 days with pro-rata refund) is noted but not redlined.

proposal.summary: Limit HDI's convenience termination to the end of the then-current term and cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that HDI should not be able to walk away mid-term and that any exit fee is capped: we have limited HDI's 90-day termination to the end of the then-current term and capped the Termination Payment at three months of Section 3 fees. The Company's existing 90 days' notice right is unchanged.

ops.text: Any termination by HDI under this Section 4.1 shall be effective only at the end of the then-current term, and any Termination Date specified in HDI's notice shall be the last day of that term.
In no event shall the Termination Payment exceed the fees payable to HDI under Section 3 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.
